preconditions.expression: isinstance(G, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in G)
preconditions.description: G is a list of lists.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(cell, int) and cell in {0, 1} for row in G for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in G is either 0 or 1.
The number of applicants (M) and jobs (N) is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(G[0]) for row in G)
preconditions.description: All rows in G have the same length.

postconditions.description: The return value is an integer.
The return value is between 0 and the minimum of the number of applicants and jobs.
